material_hold_blockers.required_repair: Require exact built-in int for offset and nbytes, an exact built-in list of exact positive built-in ints for shape, and exact equality to the expected descriptor. material_hold_blockers.required_repair: After strict structural extraction and exact UTC-seconds validation, deterministically rebuild from the extracted estimator and manifest timestamp and require full input-byte equality. Add regressions for trailing and concatenated streams, gzip header mutations, non-USTAR encodings, malformed timestamps, and all existing archive adversaries.

The generic repair predicate occurs exactly once and no rank/MLP identity law appears. Actual all-688 host/action byte parity remains future empirical evidence.

The shipping-source AST imports only standard modules, FlopScope, whestbench, and typing. It contains no Torch, NumPy, filesystem model load, role-rank/MLP identity route, benchmark target/score, pair-zero arm, fold ensemble, MPS, or fallback estimator law.

Every future model/package root and authority is null/false. The public skeleton rejects at module import before payload decoding or MLP access; export-live and meter-live discard path arguments and reject before path inspection.

The isolated suite covers H16/H64/H256, float32/float64 entry, exact/below/above 2^-30 values, zero and adjacent-to-zero final composition, and simultaneous unit permutations. It is synthetic width-9 evidence only and does not replace future width-1024/all-688 actual-state parity.

The builder reproduces identical bytes for fixed inputs and rejects the package's listed member adversaries, but the validator accepts independently constructed noncanonical gzip/tar encodings and malformed UTC timestamps.

Meter validation recomputes observations and operational admission without score/target fields. An over-limit receipt remains valid observational evidence with package admission false and cannot alter H, retry/refit, or veto accuracy.

The 18-file one-link regular package has no symlinks; all manifest bindings, the 16-component package digest, static replay, freeze receipt, and freeze replay hashes are self-consistent. Freeze consistency does not cure the two semantic defects.
